title: Settings pairing QR uses the phone's address, not 127.0.0.1
goal: A pairing QR minted from Settings on a loopback dashboard opens on the phone: the server resolves the tailnet address as nerv open --phone --qr does
acceptance: A committed join test fails first: Settings on a loopback page mints a QR whose link uses the tailnet address; with none, the old link and a hint
One helper resolves the phone address for CLI and server: config phone.url, else tailscale status (cached briefly), never an arbitrary client origin
Tests never run tailscale: the resolver is injected
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git (tailnet-fixture.ts.net); tests never run tailscale; no real tailnet name is committed.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
Every test reading live.js or web/src plus touched tests
escalation: Never accept an arbitrary origin from the client for the QR link

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: shared resolver, config key, Settings text, two join tests. Not a measurement.
